title: Depth Enables Local Entropy: Quadratic Depth Dependence in Deep Variation-Norm ReLU Regression
abstract: arXiv:2608.17434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study Gaussian regression over the explicit vector-valued Parhi--Nowak deep-RBV^2 architecture with depth L, width w, layer-sum variation budget A, and output bound B. For this O(L w^2)-parameterized architecture, the known lower and upper bounds differ by one factor of depth. We construct a local packing showing that the quadratic depth dependence is intrinsic under an explicit sample-size-dependent radius condition. The packing has log-cardinality Omega(L^2 w^2 log w); its codewords lie in an O(lambda) L^2 ball and are pairwise Omega(lambda)-separated. The main ingredients are a bias-corrected bounded-coefficient approximation theorem and balanced amplification: multiplying a depth-D ReLU network by q can be implemented using one constant channel so that every coefficient grows by only q^(1/D). translated_abstract: 我们研究了在显式向量值Parhi--Nowak深度RBV^2架构上的高斯回归，该架构具有深度L、宽度w、层和变分预算A和输出界B。对于这个O(L w^2)参数化的架构，已知的上下界相差一个深度因子。我们构建了一个局部填充，表明在显式依赖于样本大小的半径条件下，二次深度依赖是内在的。该填充的对数基数为Omega(L^2 w^2 log w)；其码字位于O(lambda) L^2球内，并且两两Omega(lambda)分离。主要成分是一个偏差校正的有界系数逼近定理和平衡放大：将深度为D的ReLU网络乘以q可以通过使用一个常数通道实现，使得每个系数仅增长q^(1/D)。转换为向量值RBV^2块后，层和代价为O(D w^2 q^(1/D))。高斯Fano方法给出了一个半径显式的下界，该下界受...
tldr: 本文证明了在深度变分范数ReLU回归中，深度平方依赖是本质的，并通过局部填充和平衡放大技术给出了显式下界，填补了上下界之间的深度因子差距。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that quadratic depth dependence is intrinsic in deep variation-norm ReLU regression, providing an explicit lower bound via local packing and balanced amplification, closing the depth-factor gap between known bounds.
